text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик doesn't show up for
training, so I
decide to go look for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There! That should keep those buttons
from
popping off.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Now then, what else did I get asked to
do...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Did someone ask you to do some sewing?

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! What brings you he—
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Ahhh! When did it get so late?!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. Silly me, getting carried
away like
this...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: Please be more careful next time.

text_block_list.text:
I will... I apologize for being such a
handful.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I comfort Супер Крик as she reflects on
her
actions and we leave the classroom
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
